correctness.rationale: The mathematical obstruction is correct, but the frozen finding also asserts that five specifically numbered published converses fail as stated. Applicability to those exact statements is not established: the package quotes Lemma 3.1(ii) and summarizes the converse conclusions and equalities, but it does not give the complete theorem hypotheses and parameter conventions needed to verify that those converses admit this preassigned map. The distinction is substantive: imposing q(m)=m at the normal median excludes q(x)=1−x, and an existential claim about a symmetry center would not be refuted by this example. Independently, normal sample reflection gives q(X_{n−i+1:n}) equal in law to 1+X_{i:n} for every i and n≥i. Translation preserves Shannon and the finite quadratic density integral, so the usual Tsallis, Rényi, information-generating and ordinary-extropy equalities follow. Finiteness follows from the order-statistic density K F^{i−1}(1−F)^{n−i} times the normal density: it is bounded with Gaussian tails and its absolute log grows at most quadratically. Yet q(X) has mean one. The quoted quantile-density equation gives q′=−f/(f∘p)=p′ and therefore q=p+C on full connected support; an anchor fixes C. The failure is the unestablished named-theorem application, not an error in these calculations or a demonstrated defense of the published converses.
residual_risks: Exact admissibility of q, the scope of the conclusion, and applicable parameter definitions in the cited five converses remain unverified; an exact source passage could settle the gap. No computation is needed for the verified conditional result.

value.rationale: The obstruction separates testing a law for symmetry about some center from identifying a prescribed center. It shows why changing among several translation-invariant information measures cannot resolve that distinction and why a location anchor, not a different density integral of the same type, is mathematically relevant. This is useful even without attributing the specific error to a particular theorem.
residual_risks: The independent assessment establishes no claim about weighted extropy, non-full-support repairs, or the practical impact of the specifically cited converses.
